derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Eyewear: prescription spectacles), not the owner's list. Price spread in this category: wide (S$40-98+ with lenses). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
